title: Crash when clicking Play in TPS demo on macOS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.beta 1a0bf5467
- Not reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta (1a0bf5467) - macOS Sequoia (15.2.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads)

### Issue description

I get a crash when clicking Play in TPS demo on macOS:

```
Thread 0::  Dispatch queue: com.apple.main-thread
0   libsystem_kernel.dylib        	       0x19d6ee6ec __psynch_cvwait + 8
1   libsystem_pthread.dylib       	       0x19d72c894 _pthread_cond_wait + 1204
2   libc++.1.dylib                	       0x19d662578 std::__1::condition_variable::wait(std::__1::unique_lock<std::__1::mutex>&) + 28

4   godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x10ae3a0d0 WorkerThreadPool::wait_for_group_task_completion(long long) + 272 (worker_thread_pool.cpp:694)
5   godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x103c0bafc RaycastOcclusionCull::RaycastHZBuffer::update_camera_rays(Transform3D const&, Vector3 const&, Vector2 const&, float, bool) + 4176 (raycast_occlusion_cull.cpp:104)
6   godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x103c14b70 RaycastOcclusionCull::buffer_update(RID, Transform3D const&, Projection const&, bool) + 808 (raycast_occlusion_cull.cpp:602)
7   godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x10936a6dc RendererSceneCull::render_camera(Ref<RenderSceneBuffers> const&, RID, RID, RID, Vector2, unsigned int, float, RID, Ref<XRInterface>&, RenderingMethod::RenderInfo*) + 3752 (renderer_scene_cull.cpp:2773)
8   godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x1093ae6d0 RendererViewport::_draw_3d(RendererViewport::Viewport*) + 688 (renderer_viewport.cpp:295)

10  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x1093b60f8 RendererViewport::draw_viewports(bool) + 6064 (renderer_viewport.cpp:868)
11  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x1095aff58 RenderingServerDefault::_draw(bool, double) + 424 (rendering_server_default.cpp:85)
12  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x1095b4460 RenderingServerDefault::draw(bool, double) + 248 (rendering_server_default.cpp:415)
13  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x10129a710 Main::iteration() + 1824 (main.cpp:4521)
14  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x1011b7b9c OS_MacOS::run() + 252 (os_macos.mm:839)
15  godot.macos.editor.arm64      	       0x10121f5ec main + 568 (godot_main_macos.mm:84)
16  dyld  
```

Full report: [report.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18786611/report.txt)

I can reproduce this on `master` but not 4.4.beta3, even if I compile it myself. I couldn't manage to bisect this though (all commits crash).

Note that in 4.4.beta3, the demo will freeze at the end of the loading screen but it won't crash. 4.4.beta2 is the last one where the demo plays correctly.

This occurs with both Metal and Vulkan rendering drivers, in Forward+ and Mobile. This does not occur when using Compatibility.

### Steps to reproduce

- Run the TPS demo on macOS (with or without the editor in the background) and click **Play**.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/godotengine/tps-demo
